name: swift-standards
description: Structured knowledge graph for SWIFT messaging standards (MT103, MT202, MT202COV, MT199) and ISO 20022 equivalents (pacs.008, pacs.009, camt.053). Covers SWIFT gpi, UETR, BIC, LEI, cover payments, Travel Rule field mapping, and sanctions screening in cross-border payments.
